items.title: CVS Health Stock Earnings Beat Comes With Breakup Plan
items.summary: CVS Health reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$108.4b and net income of US$2.2b, and outlined a plan to separate into two independent listed businesses by the first half of 2028, splitting healthcare solutions from the retail pharmacy operation. The move reverses CVS Health’s vertically integrated structure and creates distinct healthcare solutions and CVS Pharmacy entities.
